behavior.name: Haas's basic program O40001 (2023 Mill Operator's Manual, p. 102)
behavior.description: Haas's example: tool 1, a rapid to the part's top right corner, the spindle at 1000 rpm, a feed 0.1 in down at 20 in/min, a straight cut to X-4. Y-4., and back to Z and Y home. From the 2023 manual (the Next Generation Control); every code it uses has the same meaning in the 2009 Classic manual (docs/research/2026-11-16-haas-mill-programs.md). Run on the TM-1 with labelled stand-ins for the set-up (decision 0035).

why: Directions: a program's coordinates are the tool's against the table ("This defines the motion of the tool relative to the table", 2009 manual, PDF p. 148). +X is the tool to the operator's right of the part, the twin's +y (O40001, "G54 X0 Y0 is top right corner of part", cut to X-4. Y-4., 2023 manual, p. 102; O40002, "G54 X0 Y0 is center left of part", holes at +X steps, p. 107); +Y the tool towards the back, the twin's -x (the part's top right corner [INFERENCE: its top is the side away from the operator]); +Z up, the twin's +z ("Press +Z ... jog the Z-axis approximately. 1” above the part", 2009 manual, PDF p. 65). The twin's frame: +x towards the operator, +z up (decision 0012).

Home: Z at the top of its travel ("Tool Length is measured ... with the Z axis at its home position", 2009 manual, PDF p. 67; a tool change "will never move below machine zero", PDF p. 53). Y at its + end, the table towards the operator [INFERENCE: "moves the table to a position from where the part can be unloaded" by G53 Y0 (Y home), 2023 manual, pp. 102 and 105]. X at its + end, the table at its operator-left end: a STAND-IN, no source read gives it (decision 0035; the visit list's item 2 settles it).

Tool T1: 3.0 in from the spindle nose's face to its tip, a STAND-IN (the manual gives only its diameter); its length offset H01 is touched off on the twin: the machine Z where the tip meets the top of the stock ("This will take the Z position ... and put it at the tool number position", 2009 manual, PDF p. 67).
Stock: a 2.0 in block on the table's top, a STAND-IN; Z0 is its top, as the program's comment says ("Z0 is on top of the part").

Work offset G54: X and Y chosen so the program's path is centred on the table (its centre is under the spindle at X -15 in, Y -6 in, the middle of the travel); Z 0, the tool's offset carrying the height. A STAND-IN: an operator's set-up, not the machine's.
Setting 9 (units): inch, a STAND-IN; the program is written in inches ("F20. specifies that the feed rate for the motion is 20” (508 mm) / min", 2023 manual, p. 104).
The carousel's pocket 1 faces the spindle at the start, a STAND-IN.
Its path, X 0 to -4 and Y 0 to -4, centred on the table: G54 X -13, Y -4.

citations.locator: PDF p. 139, G00 Rapid Motion Positioning
citations.quote: Each axis specified is moved at the same speed, but all axes will not necessarily complete their motions at the same time.

citations.locator: PDF p. 139, G01 Linear Interpolation Motion
citations.quote: Once a G01 is started all programmed axes will move and reach the destination at the same time.
